finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 36 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`node --check` passes on all 12. No tests exist in the repo.

Left alone on purpose:

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) | Header says do not edit. Wiped on upgrade. |
| `cache.query` calls | Different object. Not part of this. |

Next: decide the vendor file. Options are a wrapper or an upstream fix.
